rate_capability.json.description: Discharge performance metrics at each tested C-rate

<C-rate label>.capacity_ah: float — total discharge capacity in amp-hours
<C-rate label>.energy_wh: float — total discharge energy in watt-hours
<C-rate label>.avg_voltage_v: float — mean discharge voltage in volts
<C-rate label>.max_temp_k: float — peak cell temperature during discharge in kelvin

rate_capability.json.notes: All values must be positive. Capacity and energy should decrease with increasing C-rate. Temperature should increase with C-rate.

voltage_decomposition.json.description: Voltage loss breakdown evaluated at 50% depth of discharge for each C-rate

<C-rate label>.reaction_overpotential_v: float — kinetic (charge-transfer) losses, absolute magnitude in volts
<C-rate label>.concentration_overpotential_v: float — mass-transport losses, absolute magnitude in volts
<C-rate label>.electrolyte_ohmic_v: float — electrolyte resistive losses, absolute magnitude in volts
<C-rate label>.solid_phase_ohmic_v: float — electrode solid-phase resistive losses, absolute magnitude in volts

voltage_decomposition.json.notes: All values must be non-negative. Total losses should increase with C-rate.

schema.critical_crate: string — highest tested C-rate at which the cell still delivers at least 80% of the lowest-rate discharge capacity
schema.peukert_exponent: float — power-law exponent characterizing the relationship between discharge current and achievable discharge time (typically 1.0–2.0 for Li-ion)

dominant_loss.<C-rate label>: string — name of the largest voltage loss component at 50% DOD
